classification.FAIL: No defined diagnostic meets its threshold, or attribution repeat diff>1e-12
classification.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Any required diagnostic undefined or no repeated evidence
classification.MIXED: Remaining defined cases; never omit failed diagnostics
classification.PASS: All four frozen diagnostic thresholds satisfied for every applicable top-k and repeat comparison

diagnostic_definitions.Spearman: rank correlation of mean-absolute attribution vectors over identical feature identities; average ranks for tied values; constants undefined
diagnostic_definitions.TV: 0.5*sum(abs(p-q)); p,q=mean-absolute vectors divided by their own positive totals; zero total undefined
diagnostic_definitions.sign_agreement: fraction of equal signs of signed mean attribution among identities with either value nonzero; empty denominator undefined

normalization_boundary: Within-vector normalization only for the explicitly defined TV diagnostic; never pool raw family scales.
seed_behavior: Same frozen populations/order/runtime across seeds; no reselection; seed affects only supported RNG controls
